description: 3-stage TOCTOU race condition in account balance debit: (1) implement account CRUD handlers with balance field and synchronous debit endpoint that blocks until complete, (2) add overdraft guard that rejects debits when balance < amount, (3) move debit processing to background goroutine for faster API response -- overdraft check reads balance in main goroutine but balance is only decremented after slow work in background goroutine. Concurrent debit requests all see the original balance, all pass the overdraft check, and each spawns its own goroutine, resulting in negative balances (overdraft).
